version_localization.promotionalText: Join a call, start a film, open a game: Mauna pauses or lowers your music by itself, then brings it back. Try every Pro feature free for 7 days.

iaps.description: Every rule, trigger and player, for life.
iaps.reviewNote: Unlocks unlimited rules, the In a call and Running triggers, lowering music instead of pausing, YouTube Music in Chrome and Safari, and a custom fade time. Open Settings › Mauna Pro, or click Get Pro at the bottom of the menu bar popover. Restore Purchase is in Settings › Mauna Pro.

iaps.description: Try everything in Mauna Pro free for 7 days.
iaps.reviewNote: A free non-consumable that starts a 7-day trial of every Mauna Pro feature, as Apple recommends for free trials of paid features. After 7 days the app returns to the free plan; nothing is charged. Offered in Settings › Mauna Pro and in the Mauna Pro window (Try Pro free for 7 days).
